collection.title: Fiat Idea 2008 to 2012 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a the Fiat idea 2008 - 2012 which requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 15" for the passengers side. This model uses the Pinch Tab Arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
